behavior.child_protocol: Handler exceptions return a fixed message and a validated exception-class field; malformed JSON returns a bounded request error.
behavior.parent_persistence: The EventBus ignores arbitrary child error text and persists only a bounded class summary or fixed fallback.
behavior.retry_behavior: Handler failure status, retry flow, and dead-letter state are unchanged.

coverage: handler exceptions do not leak credential or row payload text
malformed child JSON does not echo request contents
parent does not trust raw error strings returned by the worker child
valid exception class remains available to operators
existing EventBus retry, timeout, and dead-letter contracts remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; child process and EventBus are mocked

limitations: No worker process or database was started.
This validates protocol/source behavior; durable live delivery recovery remains open.
